main_text.p: Incumbunt literis studiorum semper amore. O, tua qui Juvenis magna cum laude sonans es, Lambent sic frondes, cingent tua tempora Lauri; Dum tu magnificè resonas de Numine summo, Ens quodnam primum summi Rectoris Olympi? An Pater Altisonans, an quovis surgat ab ortu, Qui cupis optatam virtutis tangere metam, Perge tuô studiô festino currere cursu, Principium felix; felicior exitus esto; Laus tua te sequitur, virtus in fine coronat.
Εὐφημίας ἕνεκα ἀναμφισβήτατα φιλαδελφίας ἕνεκα παχυλῶς annexum ȃ
main_text.head: JACOBO GYSIO,

p.i: Facultatum superiorum nec non Linguarum Cultore.

main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The Greek line is partly uncertain in its accents and breathings; "annexum" with a superscript mark after it is as printed. The line "Εὐφημίας ... φιλα-/δελφίας" is set in Greek with a hyphen at the line end. The faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
